issue: packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts:79 — `parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema)` is called with `googleCredentials` (the mutated local credentials) instead of the newly refreshed token response `token`, so it validates the wrong object.
reason: `googleCredentials` is validated after being mutated with the new token fields, which is the same as the old parse. The real defect is that the returned SafeParseResult object (not `.data`) is saved as `key`. That corrupts the stored credential.
finding: Google refresh passes `parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, ...)` and writes its return value, a `{success, data}` SafeParseResult, as the credential `key`. Previously the key was the parsed credentials. The stored credential is now malformed.
remedy: Use the `.data` of the parse result as `key`.
